test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 3rd December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

See the light of day
solution:
The correct answer is: **Become publicly known**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The idiom "**See the light of day**" means at a particular time, it comes into existence or is made known to the public at that time. 

 
 
• Example - *Many projects were planned and started, but none **saw the light of day.***
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom "See the light of day" is "**Become publicly known**"

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.
